sentences.en: System of the Moroccan Walls in Western Sahara set up in the 1980s
sentences.zh: 20世纪80年代在西撒哈拉建立的摩洛哥城墙系统

sentences.en: Commemoration of the 30th independence day from Spain in the Liberated Territories (2005)
sentences.zh: 解放领土纪念脱离西班牙独立 30 日（2005 年）

blocks.html_en: In the waning days of Franco's rule, and after the Green March, the Spanish government signed a tripartite agreement with Morocco and Mauritania as it moved to transfer the territory on 14 November 1975. The accords were based on a bipartite administration, and Morocco and Mauritania each moved to annex the territories, with Morocco taking control of the northern two-thirds of Western Sahara as its Southern Provinces, and Mauritania taking control of the southern third as Tiris al-Gharbiyya. Spain terminated its presence in Spanish Sahara within three months, repatriating Spanish remains from its cemeteries.[18]

sentences.en: In the waning days of Franco's rule, and after the Green March, the Spanish government signed a tripartite agreement with Morocco and Mauritania as it moved to transfer the territory on 14 November 1975.
sentences.zh: 在佛朗哥统治的末期以及绿色游行之后，西班牙政府于 1975 年 11 月 14 日移交领土，与摩洛哥和毛里塔尼亚签署了三方协议。

sentences.en: The accords were based on a bipartite administration, and Morocco and Mauritania each moved to annex the territories, with Morocco taking control of the northern two-thirds of Western Sahara as its Southern Provinces, and Mauritania taking control of the southern third as Tiris al-Gharbiyya.
sentences.zh: 该协议以两党管理为基础，摩洛哥和毛里塔尼亚各自吞并了这些领土，摩洛哥控制了西撒哈拉北部三分之二的地区作为其南部省份，毛里塔尼亚控制了南部的三分之一作为提里斯阿尔加尔比亚省。

sentences.en: Spain terminated its presence in Spanish Sahara within three months, repatriating Spanish remains from its cemeteries.[18]
sentences.zh: 西班牙在三个月内终止了在西属撒哈拉的存在，并从其墓地运回了西班牙人的遗骸。 [18]

blocks.html_en: The Moroccan and Mauritanian annexations were resisted by the Polisario Front, which had gained backing from Algeria.[19] It initiated guerrilla warfare and, in 1979, Mauritania withdrew due to pressure from Polisario, including a bombardment of its capital and other economic targets. Morocco extended its control to the rest of the territory. It gradually contained the guerrillas by setting up an extensive sand-berm in the desert (known as the Border Wall or Moroccan Wall) to exclude guerrilla fighters.[20][21] Hostilities ceased in a 1991 cease-fire, overseen by the peacekeeping mission MINURSO, under the terms of a UN Settlement Plan.

sentences.en: The Moroccan and Mauritanian annexations were resisted by the Polisario Front, which had gained backing from Algeria.[19] It initiated guerrilla warfare and, in 1979, Mauritania withdrew due to pressure from Polisario, including a bombardment of its capital and other economic targets.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥和毛里塔尼亚的吞并遭到了得到阿尔及利亚支持的波利萨里奥阵线的抵制。 [19]它发起了游击战，1979年，毛里塔尼亚迫于波利萨里奥的压力而撤军，包括轰炸其首都和其他经济目标。

sentences.en: Morocco extended its control to the rest of the territory.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥将其控制范围扩大到了其他领土。

sentences.en: It gradually contained the guerrillas by setting up an extensive sand-berm in the desert (known as the Border Wall or Moroccan Wall) to exclude guerrilla fighters.[20][21] Hostilities ceased in a 1991 cease-fire, overseen by the peacekeeping mission MINURSO, under the terms of a UN Settlement Plan.
sentences.zh: 它通过在沙漠中建立广泛的沙堤（称为边界墙或摩洛哥墙）以排除游击队战士来逐渐遏制游击队。 [20][21] 1991 年，在维和特派团西撒特派团的监督下，根据联合国解决计划的条款，敌对行动停止了。

blocks.html_en: Stalling of the referendum and Settlement Plan

sentences.en: Stalling of the referendum and Settlement Plan
sentences.zh: 推迟公投和解决计划

blocks.html_en: The referendum, originally scheduled for 1992, foresaw giving the local population the option between independence or affirming integration with Morocco, but it quickly stalled. In 1997, the Houston Agreement attempted to revive the proposal for a referendum but likewise has not had success. As of 2010, negotiations over terms have not resulted in any substantive action. At the heart of the dispute lies the question of who qualifies to be registered to participate in the referendum, and, since about the year 2000, Morocco considers that since there is no agreement on persons entitled to vote, a referendum is not possible. Meanwhile, Polisario still insisted on a referendum with independence as a clear option, without offering a solution to the problem of who is qualified to be registered to participate in it.

sentences.en: The referendum, originally scheduled for 1992, foresaw giving the local population the option between independence or affirming integration with Morocco, but it quickly stalled.
sentences.zh: 原定于 1992 年举行的全民公投预计让当地民众在独立或确认与摩洛哥合并之间做出选择，但很快就陷入停滞。

sentences.en: In 1997, the Houston Agreement attempted to revive the proposal for a referendum but likewise has not had success.
sentences.zh: 1997年，《休斯敦协议》试图恢复公投提议，但同样没有成功。

sentences.en: As of 2010, negotiations over terms have not resulted in any substantive action.
sentences.zh: 截至2010年，条款谈判尚未产生任何实质性行动。

sentences.en: At the heart of the dispute lies the question of who qualifies to be registered to participate in the referendum, and, since about the year 2000, Morocco considers that since there is no agreement on persons entitled to vote, a referendum is not possible.
sentences.zh: 争端的核心在于谁有资格登记参加全民投票的问题，大约从2000年开始，摩洛哥就认为，由于没有就有权投票的人达成一致，所以不可能举行全民投票。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Polisario still insisted on a referendum with independence as a clear option, without offering a solution to the problem of who is qualified to be registered to participate in it.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，波利萨里奥仍然坚持以独立为明确选择的公投，但没有解决谁有资格登记参加公投的问题。

blocks.html_en: Both sides blame each other for the stalling of the referendum. The Polisario has insisted on only allowing those found on the 1974 Spanish Census lists (see below) to vote, while Morocco has insisted that the census was flawed by evasion and sought the inclusion of members of Sahrawi tribes that escaped from Spanish invasion to the north of Morocco by the 19th century.

sentences.en: Both sides blame each other for the stalling of the referendum.
sentences.zh: 双方互相指责对方导致公投陷入停滞。

sentences.en: The Polisario has insisted on only allowing those found on the 1974 Spanish Census lists (see below) to vote, while Morocco has insisted that the census was flawed by evasion and sought the inclusion of members of Sahrawi tribes that escaped from Spanish invasion to the north of Morocco by the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 波利萨里奥党坚持只允许 1974 年西班牙人口普查名单上的人投票（见下文），而摩洛哥则坚称人口普查因逃避而存在缺陷，并寻求将 19 世纪摩洛哥北部因西班牙入侵而逃亡的撒哈拉部落成员纳入其中。

blocks.html_en: Efforts by the UN special envoys to find a common ground for both parties did not succeed. By 1999 the UN had identified about 85,000 voters, with nearly half of them in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara, and the others scattered between the Tindouf refugee camps, Mauritania and other places of exile. Polisario accepted this voter list, as it had done with the previous list presented by the UN (both of them originally based on the Spanish census of 1974), but Morocco refused and, as rejected voter candidates began a mass-appeals procedure, insisted that each application be scrutinized individually. This again brought the process to a halt.

sentences.en: Efforts by the UN special envoys to find a common ground for both parties did not succeed.
sentences.zh: 联合国特使为双方寻找共同点的努力并未成功。

sentences.en: By 1999 the UN had identified about 85,000 voters, with nearly half of them in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara, and the others scattered between the Tindouf refugee camps, Mauritania and other places of exile.
sentences.zh: 到1999年，联合国已经确定了大约85,000名选民，其中近一半在摩洛哥占领的西撒哈拉地区，其他人则分散在廷杜夫难民营、毛里塔尼亚和其他流亡地之间。

sentences.en: Polisario accepted this voter list, as it had done with the previous list presented by the UN (both of them originally based on the Spanish census of 1974), but Morocco refused and, as rejected voter candidates began a mass-appeals procedure, insisted that each application be scrutinized individually.
sentences.zh: 波利萨里奥接受了这份选民名单，就像它接受联合国提交的先前名单一样（两者最初都是基于 1974 年西班牙人口普查），但摩洛哥拒绝了，并且随着被拒绝的选民候选人开始大规模上诉程序，摩洛哥坚持对每份申请进行单独审查。

sentences.en: This again brought the process to a halt.
sentences.zh: 这再次使该过程停止。

blocks.html_en: According to a NATO delegation, MINURSO election observers stated in 1999, as the deadlock continued, that "if the number of voters does not rise significantly the odds were slightly on the SADR side".[22] By 2001, the process had effectively stalemated and the UN Secretary-General asked the parties for the first time to explore other, third-way solutions. Indeed, shortly after the Houston Agreement (1997), Morocco officially declared that it was "no longer necessary" to include an option of independence on the ballot, offering instead autonomy. Erik Jensen, who played an administrative role in MINURSO, wrote that neither side would agree to a voter registration in which they were destined to lose (see Western Sahara: Anatomy of a Stalemate).

sentences.en: According to a NATO delegation, MINURSO election observers stated in 1999, as the deadlock continued, that "if the number of voters does not rise significantly the odds were slightly on the SADR side".[22] By 2001, the process had effectively stalemated and the UN Secretary-General asked the parties for the first time to explore other, third-way solutions.
sentences.zh: 根据北约代表团的说法，西撒特派团选举观察员在 1999 年表示，随着僵局持续，“如果选民人数没有显着增加，那么 SADR 一方的胜算会略有上升”。 [22]到了 2001 年，这一进程实际上陷入了僵局，联合国秘书长首次要求各方探索其他第三条道路解决方案。

sentences.en: Indeed, shortly after the Houston Agreement (1997), Morocco officially declared that it was "no longer necessary" to include an option of independence on the ballot, offering instead autonomy.
sentences.zh: 事实上，休斯顿协议（1997）后不久，摩洛哥正式宣布“不再需要”在选票中包含独立选项，而是提供自治权。

sentences.en: Erik Jensen, who played an administrative role in MINURSO, wrote that neither side would agree to a voter registration in which they were destined to lose (see Western Sahara: Anatomy of a Stalemate).
sentences.zh: 在西撒特派团担任行政职务的埃里克·詹森写道，双方都不会同意选民登记，因为他们注定会失败（见西撒哈拉：僵局剖析）。

blocks.html_en: Baker Plan

sentences.zh: 贝克计划

blocks.html_en: As personal envoy of the Secretary-General, James Baker visited all sides and produced the document known as the "Baker Plan".[23] This was discussed by the United Nations Security Council in 2000, and envisioned an autonomous Western Sahara Authority (WSA), which would be followed after five years by the referendum. Every person present in the territory would be allowed to vote, regardless of birthplace and with no regard to the Spanish census. It was rejected by both sides, although it was initially derived from a Moroccan proposal. According to Baker's draft, tens of thousands of post-annexation settlers from Morocco would be granted the vote in the Sahrawi independence referendum, and the ballot would be split three ways by the inclusion of an unspecified "autonomy", further undermining the independence camp. Morocco was also allowed to keep its army in the area and retain control over all security issues during both the autonomy years and the election. In 2002, the Moroccan king stated that the referendum idea was "out of date" since it "cannot be implemented";[24] Polisario retorted that that was only because of the King's refusal to allow it to take place.

sentences.en: As personal envoy of the Secretary-General, James Baker visited all sides and produced the document known as the "Baker Plan".[23] This was discussed by the United Nations Security Council in 2000, and envisioned an autonomous Western Sahara Authority (WSA), which would be followed after five years by the referendum.
sentences.zh: 作为秘书长的私人特使，詹姆斯·贝克走访了各方，并提出了被称为“贝克计划”的文件。 [23]联合国安理会于 2000 年对此进行了讨论，并设想建立一个自治的西撒哈拉权力机构（WSA），并在五年后进行全民投票。

sentences.en: Every person present in the territory would be allowed to vote, regardless of birthplace and with no regard to the Spanish census.
sentences.zh: 该领土上的每个人都可以投票，无论出生地如何，也不考虑西班牙人口普查。

sentences.en: It was rejected by both sides, although it was initially derived from a Moroccan proposal.
sentences.zh: 尽管它最初源自摩洛哥的提案，但遭到了双方的拒绝。

sentences.en: According to Baker's draft, tens of thousands of post-annexation settlers from Morocco would be granted the vote in the Sahrawi independence referendum, and the ballot would be split three ways by the inclusion of an unspecified "autonomy", further undermining the independence camp.
sentences.zh: 根据贝克的草案，数以万计的摩洛哥吞并后定居者将在撒哈拉独立公投中获得投票权，而选票将因包含未指明的“自治权”而被分成三部分，从而进一步削弱独立阵营。

sentences.en: Morocco was also allowed to keep its army in the area and retain control over all security issues during both the autonomy years and the election.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥还被允许在该地区保留军队，并在自治年和选举期间保留对所有安全问题的控制权。

sentences.en: In 2002, the Moroccan king stated that the referendum idea was "out of date" since it "cannot be implemented";[24] Polisario retorted that that was only because of the King's refusal to allow it to take place.
sentences.zh: 2002年，摩洛哥国王表示公投想法“已经过时”，因为它“无法实施”；[24]波利萨里奥反驳说，这只是因为国王拒绝允许公投进行。

blocks.html_en: In 2003, a new version of the plan was made official, with some additions spelling out the powers of the WSA, making it less reliant on Moroccan devolution. It also provided further detail on the referendum process in order to make it harder to stall or subvert. This second draft, commonly known as Baker II, was accepted by the Polisario as a "basis of negotiations" to the surprise of many.[25] This appeared to abandon Polisario's previous position of only negotiating based on the standards of voter identification from 1991 (i.e. the Spanish census). After that, the draft quickly garnered widespread international support, culminating in the UN Security Council's unanimous endorsement of the plan in the summer of 2003.

sentences.en: In 2003, a new version of the plan was made official, with some additions spelling out the powers of the WSA, making it less reliant on Moroccan devolution.
sentences.zh: 2003年，该计划的新版本正式发布，其中增加了一些内容，明确了WSA的权力，从而减少了它对摩洛哥权力下放的依赖。

sentences.en: It also provided further detail on the referendum process in order to make it harder to stall or subvert.
sentences.zh: 它还提供了有关公投进程的更多细节，以使其更难拖延或颠覆。

sentences.en: This second draft, commonly known as Baker II, was accepted by the Polisario as a "basis of negotiations" to the surprise of many.[25] This appeared to abandon Polisario's previous position of only negotiating based on the standards of voter identification from 1991 (i.e. the Spanish census).
sentences.zh: 出人意料的是，第二份草案，通常被称为“贝克 II”，被波利萨里奥党接受为“谈判基础”。 [25]这似乎放弃了波利萨里奥此前仅根据1991年以来选民身份识别标准（即西班牙人口普查）进行谈判的立场。

sentences.en: After that, the draft quickly garnered widespread international support, culminating in the UN Security Council's unanimous endorsement of the plan in the summer of 2003.
sentences.zh: 此后，该草案迅速获得了国际社会的广泛支持，最终于2003年夏天联合国安理会一致认可了该计划。

blocks.html_en: End of the 2000s

sentences.zh: 2000年代末

blocks.html_en: Baker resigned his post at the United Nations in 2004; his term did not see the crisis resolved.[26] His resignation followed several months of failed attempts to get Morocco to enter into formal negotiations on the plan, but he was met with rejection.

sentences.en: Baker resigned his post at the United Nations in 2004; his term did not see the crisis resolved.[26] His resignation followed several months of failed attempts to get Morocco to enter into formal negotiations on the plan, but he was met with rejection.
sentences.zh: 贝克于2004年辞去联合国职务；在他的任期内危机并未得到解决。[26]在他辞职之前，几个月来一直试图让摩洛哥就该计划进行正式谈判，但遭到拒绝。

blocks.html_en: King Hassan II of Morocco initially supported the referendum idea in principle in 1982, and signed agreements with Polisario and the UN in 1991 and 1997. No major powers have expressed interest in forcing the issue, however, and Morocco has shown little interest in a real referendum. Hassan II's son and successor, Mohammed VI, has opposed any referendum on independence, and has said Morocco will never agree to one: "We shall not give up one inch of our beloved Sahara, not a grain of its sand."[27] In 2006, he created an appointed advisory body Royal Advisory Council for Saharan Affairs (CORCAS), which proposes a self-governing Western Sahara as an autonomous community within Morocco.

sentences.en: King Hassan II of Morocco initially supported the referendum idea in principle in 1982, and signed agreements with Polisario and the UN in 1991 and 1997.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥国王哈桑二世最初于1982年原则上支持公投想法，并于1991年和1997年与波利萨里奥和联合国签署了协议。

sentences.en: No major powers have expressed interest in forcing the issue, however, and Morocco has shown little interest in a real referendum.
sentences.zh: 然而，没有哪个大国表示有兴趣强制解决这个问题，摩洛哥也没有表现出对真正的全民公投的兴趣。

sentences.en: Hassan II's son and successor, Mohammed VI, has opposed any referendum on independence, and has said Morocco will never agree to one: "We shall not give up one inch of our beloved Sahara, not a grain of its sand."[27] In 2006, he created an appointed advisory body Royal Advisory Council for Saharan Affairs (CORCAS), which proposes a self-governing Western Sahara as an autonomous community within Morocco.
sentences.zh: 哈桑二世的儿子兼继任者穆罕默德六世反对任何关于独立的公投，并表示摩洛哥永远不会同意这样的公投：“我们不会放弃我们心爱的撒哈拉的一英寸，也不会放弃它的一粒沙。”[27] 2006年，他创建了一个任命的咨询机构撒哈拉事务皇家咨询委员会（CORCAS），该机构提议在摩洛哥境内建立一个自治的西撒哈拉自治区。

blocks.html_en: The UN has put forth no replacement strategy after the breakdown of Baker II, and renewed fighting has been raised as a possibility. In 2005, former United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan reported increased military activity on both sides of the front and breaches of several cease-fire provisions against strengthening military fortifications.

sentences.en: The UN has put forth no replacement strategy after the breakdown of Baker II, and renewed fighting has been raised as a possibility.
sentences.zh: 贝克二号崩溃后，联合国没有提出替代战略，并且有人提出重新爆发战斗的可能性。

sentences.en: In 2005, former United Nations Secretary-General Kofi Annan reported increased military activity on both sides of the front and breaches of several cease-fire provisions against strengthening military fortifications.
sentences.zh: 2005年，联合国前秘书长科菲·安南报告称，前线两侧的军事活动有所增加，并违反了多项针对加强军事防御工事的停火规定。

blocks.html_en: Morocco has repeatedly tried to engage Algeria in bilateral negotiations, based on its view of Polisario as the cat's paw of the Algerian military. It has received vocal support from France and occasionally (and currently) from the United States. These negotiations would define the exact limits of a Western Sahara autonomy under Moroccan rule but only after Morocco's "inalienable right" to the territory was recognized as a precondition to the talks. The Algerian government has consistently refused, claiming it has neither the will nor the right to negotiate on behalf of the Polisario Front.

sentences.en: Morocco has repeatedly tried to engage Algeria in bilateral negotiations, based on its view of Polisario as the cat's paw of the Algerian military.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥认为波利萨里奥是阿尔及利亚军方的爪牙，因此多次试图与阿尔及利亚进行双边谈判。

sentences.en: It has received vocal support from France and occasionally (and currently) from the United States.
sentences.zh: 它得到了法国的大力支持，偶尔（目前）也得到了美国的大力支持。

sentences.en: These negotiations would define the exact limits of a Western Sahara autonomy under Moroccan rule but only after Morocco's "inalienable right" to the territory was recognized as a precondition to the talks.
sentences.zh: 这些谈判将确定摩洛哥统治下西撒哈拉自治的确切范围，但前提是摩洛哥对该领土的“不可剥夺的权利”被承认为谈判的先决条件。

sentences.en: The Algerian government has consistently refused, claiming it has neither the will nor the right to negotiate on behalf of the Polisario Front.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚政府一直拒绝，声称它既没有意愿也没有权利代表波利萨里奥阵线进行谈判。

blocks.html_en: In May 2005, demonstrations and riots by supporters of independence or a referendum broke out in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara and in parts of southern Morocco (notably the town of Assa). They were met by police. Several international human rights organizations expressed concern at what they termed abuse by Moroccan security forces, and a number of Sahrawi activists have been jailed. Pro-independence Sahrawi sources, including the Polisario, have given these demonstrations the name "Independence Intifada", while most sources have tended to see the events as being of limited importance. International press and other media coverage have been sparse, and reporting is complicated by the Moroccan government's policy of strictly controlling independent media coverage within the territory.

sentences.en: In May 2005, demonstrations and riots by supporters of independence or a referendum broke out in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara and in parts of southern Morocco (notably the town of Assa).
sentences.zh: 2005年5月，摩洛哥占领的西撒哈拉地区和摩洛哥南部部分地区（特别是阿萨镇）爆发了独立或公投支持者的示威和骚乱。
他们遇到了警察。

sentences.en: Several international human rights organizations expressed concern at what they termed abuse by Moroccan security forces, and a number of Sahrawi activists have been jailed.
sentences.zh: 一些国际人权组织对摩洛哥安全部队的虐待行为表示担忧，一些撒哈拉活动人士已被监禁。

sentences.en: Pro-independence Sahrawi sources, including the Polisario, have given these demonstrations the name "Independence Intifada", while most sources have tended to see the events as being of limited importance.
sentences.zh: 支持独立的撒哈拉消息人士，包括波利萨里奥党，将这些示威活动称为“独立起义”，而大多数消息人士倾向于认为这些事件的重要性有限。

sentences.en: International press and other media coverage have been sparse, and reporting is complicated by the Moroccan government's policy of strictly controlling independent media coverage within the territory.
sentences.zh: 国际新闻和其他媒体的报道很少，摩洛哥政府严格控制境内独立媒体报道的政策使报道变得复杂。

blocks.html_en: <figcaption id="mwASw">A demonstration in Madrid for the independence of Western Sahara</figcaption>

sentences.en: A demonstration in Madrid for the independence of Western Sahara
sentences.zh: 马德里举行示威要求西撒哈拉独立

blocks.html_en: Demonstrations and protests still occur, even after Morocco declared in February 2006 that it was contemplating a plan for devolving a limited variant of autonomy to the territory but still explicitly refused any referendum on independence. As of January 2007, the plan had not been made public, though the Moroccan government claimed that it was more or less complete.[28]

sentences.en: Demonstrations and protests still occur, even after Morocco declared in February 2006 that it was contemplating a plan for devolving a limited variant of autonomy to the territory but still explicitly refused any referendum on independence.

sentences.en: As of January 2007, the plan had not been made public, though the Moroccan government claimed that it was more or less complete.[28]
sentences.zh: 截至 2007 年 1 月，该计划尚未公开，但摩洛哥政府声称该计划已基本完成。 [28]

blocks.html_en: Polisario has intermittently threatened to resume fighting, referring to the Moroccan refusal of a referendum as a breach of the cease-fire terms, but most observers seem to consider armed conflict unlikely without the green light from Algeria, which houses the Sahrawis' refugee camps and has been the main military sponsor of the movement.

sentences.en: Polisario has intermittently threatened to resume fighting, referring to the Moroccan refusal of a referendum as a breach of the cease-fire terms, but most observers seem to consider armed conflict unlikely without the green light from Algeria, which houses the Sahrawis' refugee camps and has been the main military sponsor of the movement.
sentences.zh: 波利萨里奥断断续续地威胁要恢复战斗，称摩洛哥拒绝公投违反了停火条款，但大多数观察家似乎认为，如果没有阿尔及利亚的绿灯，武装冲突就不太可能发生。阿尔及利亚是撒哈拉难民营的所在地，也是该运动的主要军事支持者。

blocks.html_en: In April 2007, the government of Morocco suggested that a self-governing entity, through the CORCAS, should govern the territory with some degree of autonomy for Western Sahara. The project was presented to the UN Security Council in mid-April 2007. The stalemating of the Moroccan proposal options has led the UN in the recent "Report of the UN Secretary-General" to ask the parties to enter into direct and unconditional negotiations to reach a mutually accepted political solution.[29]

blocks.html_en: In October 2010, Gadaym Izik camp was set up near Laayoune as a protest by displaced Sahrawi people about their living conditions. It was home to more than 12,000 people. In November 2010, Moroccan security forces entered Gadaym Izik camp in the early hours of the morning, using helicopters and water cannon to force people to leave. The Polisario Front said Moroccan security forces had killed a 26-year-old protester at the camp, a claim denied by Morocco. Protesters in Laayoune threw stones at police and set fire to tires and vehicles. Several buildings, including a TV station, were also set on fire. Moroccan officials said five security personnel had been killed in the unrest.[30]

sentences.en: In October 2010, Gadaym Izik camp was set up near Laayoune as a protest by displaced Sahrawi people about their living conditions.
sentences.zh: 2010 年 10 月，为了抗议流离失所的撒哈拉人对其生活条件的抗议，在阿尤恩附近设立了加达姆·伊兹克 (Gadaym Izik) 营地。

sentences.en: It was home to more than 12,000 people.

sentences.zh: 阿尤恩的抗议者向警察投掷石块，并纵火焚烧轮胎和车辆。

sentences.zh: 摩洛哥官员称，五名安全人员在骚乱中丧生。 [30]

blocks.html_en: On 15 November 2010, the Moroccan government accused the Algerian secret services of orchestrating and financing the Gadaym Izik camp with the intent to destabilize the region. The Spanish press was accused of mounting a campaign of disinformation to support the Sahrawi initiative, and all foreign reporters were either prevented from traveling or else expelled from the area.[31] The protest coincided with a fresh round of negotiations at the UN.[32]

blocks.html_en: In 2016, the European Union (EU) declared that "Western Sahara is not part of Moroccan territory."[33] In March 2016, Morocco "expelled more than 70 U.N. civilian staffers with MINURSO" due to strained relations after Ban Ki-moon called Morocco's annexation of Western Sahara an "occupation".[34]

sentences.en: In 2016, the European Union (EU) declared that "Western Sahara is not part of Moroccan territory."[33] In March 2016, Morocco "expelled more than 70 U.N.
sentences.zh: 2016年，欧盟（EU）宣布“西撒哈拉不是摩洛哥领土的一部分。”[33] 2016年3月，摩洛哥“驱逐了70多名联合国人员”。

sentences.en: civilian staffers with MINURSO" due to strained relations after Ban Ki-moon called Morocco's annexation of Western Sahara an "occupation".[34]
sentences.zh: [34] 由于潘基文称摩洛哥吞并西撒哈拉为“占领”，关系紧张，西撒特派团的文职工作人员“被解雇”。

sentences.en: As part of the Israel–Morocco normalization agreement, the United States became the first state to recognize Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara.
sentences.zh: 作为以色列-摩洛哥关系正常化协议的一部分，美国成为第一个承认摩洛哥对西撒哈拉拥有主权的国家。

blocks.html_en: The 2020s have seen a diplomatic shift in favor of Morocco, with several African states opening consulates accredited to Morocco in Western Sahara, implying de facto recognition.[35] Even so, the Polisario Front has seen limited victories in cases brought before the African Court and the European Court of Justice. In November 2020, the ceasefire between the Polisario Front and Morocco broke down, leading to ongoing armed clashes between both sides.

sentences.en: The 2020s have seen a diplomatic shift in favor of Morocco, with several African states opening consulates accredited to Morocco in Western Sahara, implying de facto recognition.[35] Even so, the Polisario Front has seen limited victories in cases brought before the African Court and the European Court of Justice.
sentences.zh: 2020 年代，外交发生了有利于摩洛哥的转变，几个非洲国家在西撒哈拉开设了驻摩洛哥的领事馆，这意味着事实上的承认。 [35]即便如此，波利萨里奥阵线在非洲法院和欧洲法院提起的案件中取得的胜利有限。

sentences.en: In November 2020, the ceasefire between the Polisario Front and Morocco broke down, leading to ongoing armed clashes between both sides.
sentences.zh: 2020年11月，波利萨里奥阵线与摩洛哥之间的停火破裂，导致双方武装冲突持续。

blocks.html_en: On 10 December 2020, the United States announced that it would recognize full Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara in exchange for Morocco normalizing relations with Israel with a view for subsequent establishment of diplomatic relations.[36][37][38] Following this, Israel officially recognized Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara in July 2023.[39][40]

sentences.en: On 10 December 2020, the United States announced that it would recognize full Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara in exchange for Morocco normalizing relations with Israel with a view for subsequent establishment of diplomatic relations.[36][37][38] Following this, Israel officially recognized Moroccan sovereignty over Western Sahara in July 2023.[39][40]
sentences.zh: 2020年12月10日，美国宣布承认摩洛哥对西撒哈拉的全部主权，以换取摩洛哥与以色列关系正常化，以期随后建立外交关系。[36][37][38]此后，以色列于2023年7月正式承认摩洛哥对西撒哈拉的主权。[39][40]

blocks.html_en: In February 2021, Morocco proposed to Spain the creation of an autonomy for Western Sahara under the sovereignty of the King of Morocco.[41] In March 2022, the Spanish government abandoned its traditional position of neutrality in the conflict, siding with the Moroccan government and recognizing the autonomy proposal "as the most serious, realistic and credible basis for the resolution of the dispute".[42] This sudden turnaround was generally rejected by both the Opposition, the parties that make up the government coalition, the Polisario Front, as well as members of the governing party, who support a solution "that respects the democratic will of the Saharawi people".[43]

sentences.en: In February 2021, Morocco proposed to Spain the creation of an autonomy for Western Sahara under the sovereignty of the King of Morocco.[41] In March 2022, the Spanish government abandoned its traditional position of neutrality in the conflict, siding with the Moroccan government and recognizing the autonomy proposal "as the most serious, realistic and credible basis for the resolution of the dispute".[42] This sudden turnaround was generally rejected by both the Opposition, the parties that make up the government coalition, the Polisario Front, as well as members of the governing party, who support a solution "that respects the democratic will of the Saharawi people".[43]
sentences.zh: 2021年2月，摩洛哥向西班牙提议在摩洛哥国王的主权下建立西撒哈拉自治权。 [41] 2022年3月，西班牙政府放弃了在冲突中传统的中立立场，站在摩洛哥政府一边，承认自治提案“是解决争端最严肃、现实和可信的基础”。 [42]这一突然的转变普遍遭到反对派、组成政府联盟的政党波利萨里奥阵线以及执政党成员的普遍拒绝，他们支持“尊重撒哈拉人民民主意愿”的解决方案。 [43]

blocks.html_en: In October 2024, in a speech to the Parliament of Morocco, French President Emmanuel Macron backed Morocco's autonomy proposal.[44] Macron also unveiled a €25 million ($27 million) investment in Guelmim-Oued Noun, which includes part of the Western Sahara.[45] In June 2025, UK Foreign Secretary David Lammy stated that Morocco's plan for autonomy in Western Sahara represented "the most credible, viable and pragmatic" solution to the conflict.[46] In July 2025, the Copernicus Programme corrected its cartography, separating Morocco from Western Sahara.[47]

sentences.en: In October 2024, in a speech to the Parliament of Morocco, French President Emmanuel Macron backed Morocco's autonomy proposal.[44] Macron also unveiled a €25 million ($27 million) investment in Guelmim-Oued Noun, which includes part of the Western Sahara.[45] In June 2025, UK Foreign Secretary David Lammy stated that Morocco's plan for autonomy in Western Sahara represented "the most credible, viable and pragmatic" solution to the conflict.[46] In July 2025, the Copernicus Programme corrected its cartography, separating Morocco from Western Sahara.[47]
sentences.zh: 2024年10月，法国总统马克龙在摩洛哥议会发表讲话，支持摩洛哥的自治提案。 [44]马克龙还公布了对 Guelmim-Oued Noun 的 2500 万欧元（2700 万美元）投资，其中包括西撒哈拉的一部分。 [45] 2025年6月，英国外交大臣戴维·拉米表示，摩洛哥的西撒哈拉自治计划代表了“最可信、可行和务实”的冲突解决方案。 [46] 2025年7月，哥白尼计划更正了其地图，将摩洛哥与西撒哈拉分开。 [47]

blocks.html_en: In October 2025, the United Nations Security Council referenced Morocco's autonomy proposal as a basis for negotiations "with a view to achieving a just, lasting and mutually acceptable resolution to the dispute, consistent with the UN Charter" and welcomed "any constructive suggestions by the parties in response to the Autonomy Proposal". The resolution recognised that "genuine autonomy could represent a most feasible outcome" and encouraged the parties to submit ideas to support "a final mutually acceptable solution".[48][49]

sentences.en: In October 2025, the United Nations Security Council referenced Morocco's autonomy proposal as a basis for negotiations "with a view to achieving a just, lasting and mutually acceptable resolution to the dispute, consistent with the UN Charter" and welcomed "any constructive suggestions by the parties in response to the Autonomy Proposal".
sentences.zh: 2025年10月，联合国安理会将摩洛哥的自治提案作为谈判的基础，“以期根据《联合国宪章》达成公正、持久和双方都能接受的争端解决方案”，并欢迎“各方针对自治提案提出的任何建设性建议”。

sentences.en: The resolution recognised that "genuine autonomy could represent a most feasible outcome" and encouraged the parties to submit ideas to support "a final mutually acceptable solution".[48][49]
sentences.zh: 该决议承认“真正的自治可以代表最可行的结果”，并鼓励各方提出想法以支持“最终的双方都能接受的解决方案”。 [48][49]

blocks.html_en: Western Sahara is located on the north-west coast in West Africa and on the cusp of North Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean to the northwest, Morocco to the north-northeast, Algeria to the east-northeast, and Mauritania to the east and south.[50]

sentences.en: Western Sahara is located on the north-west coast in West Africa and on the cusp of North Africa, bordering the North Atlantic Ocean to the northwest, Morocco to the north-northeast, Algeria to the east-northeast, and Mauritania to the east and south.[50]
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉位于西非西北海岸和北非的尖端，西北与北大西洋接壤，东北北部与摩洛哥接壤，东北东部与阿尔及利亚接壤，东部和南部与毛里塔尼亚接壤。 [50]

blocks.html_en: Among the most arid and inhospitable on the planet, the land along the coast is low flat desert and rises, especially in the north, to small mountains reaching up to 600 metres (2,000 ft) on the eastern side.

sentences.en: Among the most arid and inhospitable on the planet, the land along the coast is low flat desert and rises, especially in the north, to small mountains reaching up to 600 metres (2,000 ft) on the eastern side.
sentences.zh: 沿海地区是地球上最干旱、最荒凉的地区之一，沿海地区是低洼平坦的沙漠，特别是在北部，东侧的小山脉高达 600 米（2,000 英尺）。

blocks.html_en: While the area can experience flash flooding in the spring, there are no permanent streams. At times, a cool off-shore current can produce fog and heavy dew.

sentences.en: While the area can experience flash flooding in the spring, there are no permanent streams.
sentences.zh: 虽然该地区在春季可能会发生山洪暴发，但没有永久性的溪流。

sentences.en: At times, a cool off-shore current can produce fog and heavy dew.
sentences.zh: 有时，凉爽的离岸洋流会产生雾和浓露。

blocks.html_en: The interior experiences extreme summer heat, with average highs reaching 43–45 °C (109–113 °F) in July and in August; during winter, days are still hot to very hot, with average highs from 25 to 30 °C (77 to 86 °F); however, in the northern part of the territory, the thermometer may drop below 0 °C (32 °F) at night and it can be freezing in December and in January, although this is rare.

sentences.en: The interior experiences extreme summer heat, with average highs reaching 43–45 °C (109–113 °F) in July and in August; during winter, days are still hot to very hot, with average highs from 25 to 30 °C (77 to 86 °F); however, in the northern part of the territory, the thermometer may drop below 0 °C (32 °F) at night and it can be freezing in December and in January, although this is rare.
sentences.zh: 夏季室内极端炎热，7 月和 8 月平均最高温度达到 43–45 °C (109–113 °F)；冬季，天气仍然炎热至极热，平均最高温度为 25 至 30 °C（77 至 86 °F）；然而，在该领土北部，夜间温度可能会降至 0 °C (32 °F) 以下，12 月和 1 月可能会结冰，尽管这种情况很少见。

blocks.html_en: Western Sahara contains four terrestrial ecoregions: Saharan halophytics, Mediterranean acacia-argania dry woodlands and succulent thickets, Atlantic coastal desert, and North Saharan steppe and woodlands.[51]

sentences.en: Western Sahara contains four terrestrial ecoregions: Saharan halophytics, Mediterranean acacia-argania dry woodlands and succulent thickets, Atlantic coastal desert, and North Saharan steppe and woodlands.[51]
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉包含四个陆地生态区：撒哈拉盐生植物、地中海金合欢-阿干树干燥林地和肉质灌木丛、大西洋沿岸沙漠以及北撒哈拉草原和林地。 [51]

blocks.html_en: Sovereignty over Western Sahara is contested between Morocco and the Polisario Front and its legal status remains unresolved. The United Nations considers it to be a "non-self-governing territory".

sentences.en: Sovereignty over Western Sahara is contested between Morocco and the Polisario Front and its legal status remains unresolved.

sentences.zh: 联合国认为它是“非自治领土”。

blocks.html_en: Formally, Morocco is administered by a bicameral parliament under a constitutional monarchy wherein the monarch retains significant powers, such as the capacity to appoint the government and to dissolve parliament. The last elections to the parliament's lower house were deemed reasonably free and fair by international observers.[citation needed] The Morocco-occupied parts of Western Sahara are divided into several provinces that are treated as integral parts of the kingdom. The Moroccan government heavily subsidizes the Saharan provinces under its occupation with cut-rate fuel and related subsidies, to appease nationalist dissent and attract immigrants from Sahrawis and other communities in Morocco proper.[52]

sentences.en: Formally, Morocco is administered by a bicameral parliament under a constitutional monarchy wherein the monarch retains significant powers, such as the capacity to appoint the government and to dissolve parliament.
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥在形式上由君主立宪制下的两院议会管理，其中君主保留重要权力，例如任命政府和解散议会的能力。

sentences.en: The last elections to the parliament's lower house were deemed reasonably free and fair by international observers.[citation needed] The Morocco-occupied parts of Western Sahara are divided into several provinces that are treated as integral parts of the kingdom.
sentences.zh: 国际观察员认为议会下议院的上次选举相当自由和公平。[需要引用] 摩洛哥占领的西撒哈拉地区分为几个省份，这些省份被视为该王国不可分割的一部分。

sentences.en: The Moroccan government heavily subsidizes the Saharan provinces under its occupation with cut-rate fuel and related subsidies, to appease nationalist dissent and attract immigrants from Sahrawis and other communities in Morocco proper.[52]
sentences.zh: 摩洛哥政府为其占领下的撒哈拉省份提供大量补贴，包括降低燃料价格和相关补贴，以安抚民族主义异议并吸引来自撒哈拉人和摩洛哥本土其他社区的移民。 [52]

blocks.html_en: The exiled government of the self-proclaimed Sahrawi Arab Democratic Republic (SADR) is a form of single-party parliamentary and presidential system, but according to its constitution, this will be changed into a multi-party system at the achievement of independence. It is presently based at the Tindouf refugee camps in Algeria, which it controls. It also controls the part of Western Sahara to the east of the Moroccan Wall, known as the liberated territories. This area has a very small population, estimated to be approximately 30,000 nomads.[53] The Moroccan government views it as a no-man's land patrolled by UN troops. The SADR government whose troops also patrol the area have proclaimed a village in the area, Bir Lehlou and Tifariti, as SADR's former and actual temporary factual capitals.

sentences.zh: 自称的阿拉伯撒哈拉民主共和国（SADR）的流亡政府是一党议会和总统制，但根据其宪法，在实现独立后将改为多党制。

sentences.en: It is presently based at the Tindouf refugee camps in Algeria, which it controls.

sentences.zh: 它还控制着摩洛哥墙以东的西撒哈拉部分地区，即所谓的解放领土。

blocks.html_en: On 18 December 2019, the Comoros became the first nation to open a consulate in Laayoune in support of Moroccan claims to Western Sahara.[54] In January 2020, The Gambia[55] and Guinea[56] opened consulates in Dakhla; meanwhile, Gabon opened a consulate general in Laayoune.[57] As part of the Moroccan-Israeli normalisation deal, the United States established a temporary consulate post in Dakhla in January 2021 as a transition to establishing a permanent consulate within the near future.[37][58]

blocks.html_en: The Western Sahara conflict has resulted in severe human-rights abuses, constantly reported by external reporters and human rights activists,[63] most notably the displacement of tens of thousands of Sahrawi civilians from the country, the expulsion of tens of thousands of Moroccan civilians by the Algerian government from Algeria,[64] and numerous casualties of war and repression.

sentences.en: The Western Sahara conflict has resulted in severe human-rights abuses, constantly reported by external reporters and human rights activists,[63] most notably the displacement of tens of thousands of Sahrawi civilians from the country, the expulsion of tens of thousands of Moroccan civilians by the Algerian government from Algeria,[64] and numerous casualties of war and repression.
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉冲突导致了严重的侵犯人权行为，外部记者和人权活动人士不断报道，[63] 最引人注目的是数万名撒哈拉平民流离失所，阿尔及利亚政府将数万名摩洛哥平民驱逐出阿尔及利亚，[64] 以及战争和镇压造成无数人员伤亡。

blocks.html_en: During the war years (1975–1991), both sides accused each other of targeting civilians. Moroccan claims of Polisario terrorism have generally had little to no support abroad, with the US, European Union, African Union and UN all refusing to include the group on their lists of terrorist organizations. Polisario leaders maintain that they are ideologically opposed to terrorism, and insist that collective punishment and forced disappearances among Sahrawi civilians[65] should be considered state terrorism on the part of Morocco.[66] Both Morocco and the Polisario additionally accuse each other of violating the human rights of the populations under their control, in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara and the Tindouf refugee camps in Algeria, respectively. Morocco and organizations such as France Libertés consider Algeria to be directly responsible for any crimes committed on its territory, and accuse the country of having been directly involved in such violations.[67][unreliable source?]

sentences.en: During the war years (1975–1991), both sides accused each other of targeting civilians.

blocks.html_en: The Polisario Front has received criticism from the French organization France Libertes on its treatment of Moroccan prisoners of war,[89] and on its general behaviour in the Tindouf refugee camps in reports by the Belgian commercial counseling society ESISC.[90][91] Social anthropologist of the Sahara Desert, Konstantina Isidoros, said that in both 2005 and 2008, ESISC issued two near-identical reports proclaiming distorted truths that Polisario is evolving to new fears terrorism,[clarification needed] radical Islamism or international crime. According to Isidoros "lies appear to play some peculiar importance in this report".[92][clarification needed] Jacob Mundi[93] considers this report as a part of the Moroccan propaganda designed to discredit the Polisario Front.[94]

blocks.html_en: Western Sahara was partitioned between Morocco and Mauritania in April 1976, with Morocco acquiring the northern two-thirds of the territory.[97] When Mauritania, under pressure from Polisario guerrillas, abandoned all claims to its portion in August 1979, Morocco moved to occupy that sector shortly thereafter and has since asserted administrative control over the whole territory.[97] The official Moroccan government name for Western Sahara is the "Southern Provinces", consisting of the Río de Oro and Saguia el-Hamra regions.

sentences.en: Western Sahara was partitioned between Morocco and Mauritania in April 1976, with Morocco acquiring the northern two-thirds of the territory.[97] When Mauritania, under pressure from Polisario guerrillas, abandoned all claims to its portion in August 1979, Morocco moved to occupy that sector shortly thereafter and has since asserted administrative control over the whole territory.[97] The official Moroccan government name for Western Sahara is the "Southern Provinces", consisting of the Río de Oro and Saguia el-Hamra regions.
sentences.zh: 1976 年 4 月，西撒哈拉被摩洛哥和毛里塔尼亚瓜分，摩洛哥获得了北部三分之二的领土。 [97]当毛里塔尼亚在波利萨里奥游击队的压力下于 1979 年 8 月放弃对其部分领土的所有主张时，摩洛哥随后不久就占领了该地区，并从此对整个领土实行了行政控制。 [97]摩洛哥政府对西撒哈拉的官方名称是“南部省份”，由里奥德奥罗和萨基亚阿姆拉地区组成。

blocks.html_en: The portion not under the occupation of the Moroccan government is the area that lies between the border wall and the actual border with Algeria and Mauritania. The Polisario Front claims to run this as the Free Zone on behalf of the SADR. The area is patrolled by Polisario forces,[98] and access is restricted, even among Sahrawis, due to the harsh climate of the Sahara, the military conflict and the abundance of land mines. Landmine Action UK undertook preliminary survey work by visiting the Polisario-controlled area of Western Sahara in October 2005 and February–March 2006. A field assessment in the vicinity of Bir Lahlou, Tifariti and the berms revealed that the densest concentrations of mines are in front of the berms. Mines were laid in zigzags up to one meter apart, and in some parts of the berms, there are three rows of mines. There are also berms in the Moroccan-occupied zone, around Dakhla and stretching from Boujdour, including Smara on the Moroccan border. Mine-laying was not restricted to the vicinity of the berms though, as towns throughout the Polisario-controlled areas, such as Bir Lehlou and Tifariti, are ringed by mines laid by Moroccan forces.[99]

sentences.en: The portion not under the occupation of the Moroccan government is the area that lies between the border wall and the actual border with Algeria and Mauritania.
sentences.zh: 不属于摩洛哥政府占领的部分是边界墙与阿尔及利亚和毛里塔尼亚实际边界之间的地区。

sentences.en: The Polisario Front claims to run this as the Free Zone on behalf of the SADR.
sentences.zh: 波利萨里奥阵线声称代表 SADR 将这里作为自由区运营。

sentences.en: The area is patrolled by Polisario forces,[98] and access is restricted, even among Sahrawis, due to the harsh climate of the Sahara, the military conflict and the abundance of land mines.
sentences.zh: 该地区由波利萨里奥部队巡逻，[98] 由于撒哈拉恶劣的气候、军事冲突和大量地雷，即使在撒哈拉人中，进入也受到限制。

sentences.en: Landmine Action UK undertook preliminary survey work by visiting the Polisario-controlled area of Western Sahara in October 2005 and February–March 2006.
sentences.zh: 英国地雷行动组织于2005年10月和2006年2月至3月访问了西撒哈拉波利萨里奥控制地区，开展了初步调查工作。

sentences.en: A field assessment in the vicinity of Bir Lahlou, Tifariti and the berms revealed that the densest concentrations of mines are in front of the berms.
sentences.zh: 对 Bir Lahlou、Tifariti 和护堤附近的实地评估显示，地雷最密集的地方是护堤前面。

sentences.en: Mines were laid in zigzags up to one meter apart, and in some parts of the berms, there are three rows of mines.
sentences.zh: 地雷呈锯齿状布设，相距一米，在护堤的某些地方，布有三排地雷。

sentences.en: There are also berms in the Moroccan-occupied zone, around Dakhla and stretching from Boujdour, including Smara on the Moroccan border.
sentences.zh: 在摩洛哥占领区、达赫拉周围以及从布支杜尔延伸的地区也有护堤，其中包括摩洛哥边境的斯马拉。

sentences.en: Mine-laying was not restricted to the vicinity of the berms though, as towns throughout the Polisario-controlled areas, such as Bir Lehlou and Tifariti, are ringed by mines laid by Moroccan forces.[99]
sentences.zh: 不过，埋雷并不局限于护堤附近，因为整个波利萨里奥控制区的城镇，如 Bir Lehlou 和 Tifariti，都被摩洛哥军队埋设的地雷所包围。 [99]

blocks.html_en: Despite this, the area is traveled and inhabited by many Sahrawi nomads from the Tindouf refugee camps of Algeria and the Sahrawi communities in Mauritania.[53] United Nations MINURSO forces are also present in the area. The UN forces oversee the cease-fire between Polisario and Morocco agreed upon in the 1991 Settlement Plan.[100]

sentences.en: Despite this, the area is traveled and inhabited by many Sahrawi nomads from the Tindouf refugee camps of Algeria and the Sahrawi communities in Mauritania.[53] United Nations MINURSO forces are also present in the area.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，该地区仍然有许多来自阿尔及利亚廷杜夫难民营和毛里塔尼亚撒哈拉社区的撒哈拉游牧民出行和居住。 [53]联合国西撒特派团部队也驻扎在该地区。

sentences.en: The UN forces oversee the cease-fire between Polisario and Morocco agreed upon in the 1991 Settlement Plan.[100]
sentences.zh: 联合国部队负责监督波利萨里奥和摩洛哥在 1991 年解决计划中达成的停火协议。 [100]

blocks.html_en: The Polisario forces of the Sahrawi People's Liberation Army (SPLA) in the area are divided into seven "military regions", each controlled by a top commander reporting to the President of the proclaimed republic.[98][101] The total size of the Polisario's guerrilla army present in this area is unknown, but it is believed to number a few thousand men, despite many combatants being demobilized due to the cease-fire.[101]

sentences.en: The Polisario forces of the Sahrawi People's Liberation Army (SPLA) in the area are divided into seven "military regions", each controlled by a top commander reporting to the President of the proclaimed republic.[98][101] The total size of the Polisario's guerrilla army present in this area is unknown, but it is believed to number a few thousand men, despite many combatants being demobilized due to the cease-fire.[101]
sentences.zh: 该地区撒哈拉人民解放军（SPLA）的波利萨里奥部队分为七个“军事区”，每个军事区由一名向所宣布的共和国总统报告的最高指挥官控制。 [98][101]该地区波利萨里奥游击队的总规模尚不清楚，但据信有几千人，尽管许多战斗人员因停火而复员。 [101]

blocks.html_en: Major Sahrawi political events, such as Polisario congresses and sessions of the Sahrawi National Council (the SADR parliament in exile) are held in the Free Zone (especially in Tifariti and Bir Lehlou), since it is politically and symbolically important to conduct political affairs on Sahrawi territory. In 2005, MINURSO lodged a complaint to the Security Council of the United Nations for "military maneuvers with real fire which extends to restricted areas" by Morocco.[102] A concentration of forces for the commemoration of the Saharawi Republic's 30th anniversary[103] were subject to condemnation by the United Nations,[104] as it was considered an example of a cease-fire violation to bring such a large force concentration into the area. In late 2009, Moroccan troops performed military maneuvers near Umm Dreiga, in the exclusion zone, violating the cease-fire. Both parties have been accused of such violations by the UN, but to date there has been no serious hostile action from either side since 1991.

sentences.en: Major Sahrawi political events, such as Polisario congresses and sessions of the Sahrawi National Council (the SADR parliament in exile) are held in the Free Zone (especially in Tifariti and Bir Lehlou), since it is politically and symbolically important to conduct political affairs on Sahrawi territory.
sentences.zh: 撒哈拉的重大政治活动，如波利萨里奥代表大会和撒哈拉全国委员会（流亡的 SADR 议会）会议都在自由区举行（特别是在提法里提和比尔莱卢），因为在撒哈拉领土上开展政治事务具有重要的政治和象征意义。

sentences.en: In 2005, MINURSO lodged a complaint to the Security Council of the United Nations for "military maneuvers with real fire which extends to restricted areas" by Morocco.[102] A concentration of forces for the commemoration of the Saharawi Republic's 30th anniversary[103] were subject to condemnation by the United Nations,[104] as it was considered an example of a cease-fire violation to bring such a large force concentration into the area.
sentences.zh: 2005年，西撒特派团向联合国安理会投诉摩洛哥“进行真火军事演习，延伸至禁区”。 [102]为纪念撒哈拉共和国成立 30 周年而集结部队的行为受到了联合国的谴责，[104] 因为将如此大规模的部队集结到该地区被认为是违反停火的一个例子。

sentences.en: In late 2009, Moroccan troops performed military maneuvers near Umm Dreiga, in the exclusion zone, violating the cease-fire.
sentences.zh: 2009年底，摩洛哥军队在禁区乌姆德雷加附近进行军事演习，违反了停火协议。

sentences.en: Both parties have been accused of such violations by the UN, but to date there has been no serious hostile action from either side since 1991.
sentences.zh: 双方都被联合国指控犯有此类违法行为，但自 1991 年以来，迄今为止双方都没有采取严重的敌对行动。

blocks.html_en: UN sponsored peace talks, the first in six years between Morocco and Polisario, were held in Geneva on 5 December 2018, with both sides agreeing to meet again in a few months for further talks.[105][106]

sentences.en: UN sponsored peace talks, the first in six years between Morocco and Polisario, were held in Geneva on 5 December 2018, with both sides agreeing to meet again in a few months for further talks.[105][106]
sentences.zh: 联合国主持的和平谈判于 2018 年 12 月 5 日在日内瓦举行，这是摩洛哥和波利萨里奥之间六年来的首次和平谈判，双方同意在几个月后再次会面进行进一步谈判。 [105][106]

blocks.html_en: During the joint Moroccan–Mauritanian occupation of the area, the Mauritanian-occupied part, roughly corresponding to Saquia el-Hamra, was known as Tiris al-Gharbiyya.

sentences.en: During the joint Moroccan–Mauritanian occupation of the area, the Mauritanian-occupied part, roughly corresponding to Saquia el-Hamra, was known as Tiris al-Gharbiyya.
sentences.zh: 在摩洛哥和毛里塔尼亚联合占领该地区期间，毛里塔尼亚占领的部分（大致相当于萨基亚哈姆拉）被称为蒂里斯阿尔加尔比亚（Tiris al-Gharbiyya）。

sentences.zh: 经济

blocks.html_en: <figcaption id="mwA4A">Natural products in a pharmacy</figcaption>

sentences.zh: 药房里的天然产品

blocks.html_en: Aside from its rich fishing waters and phosphate reserves, Western Sahara has few natural resources and lacks sufficient rainfall and freshwater resources for most agricultural activities. There is speculation that there may be off-shore oil and natural gas fields, but the debate persists as to whether these resources can be profitably exploited, and if this would be legally permitted due to the non-self-governing status of Western Sahara (see below).

sentences.en: Aside from its rich fishing waters and phosphate reserves, Western Sahara has few natural resources and lacks sufficient rainfall and freshwater resources for most agricultural activities.
sentences.zh: 除了丰富的渔业水域和磷酸盐储量外，西撒哈拉自然资源很少，缺乏足够的降雨和淡水资源来进行大多数农业活动。

sentences.en: There is speculation that there may be off-shore oil and natural gas fields, but the debate persists as to whether these resources can be profitably exploited, and if this would be legally permitted due to the non-self-governing status of Western Sahara (see below).
sentences.zh: 有人猜测可能存在近海石油和天然气田，但对于这些资源是否可以有利可图地开采，以及由于西撒哈拉的非自治地位是否在法律上允许，争论仍然存在（见下文）。

blocks.html_en: Western Sahara's phosphate mine at Bou Craa produces approximately 10% of Morocco's annual phosphate output.[107] This mine has the longest conveyor belt in the world, at 98 km (61 mi).[108] However, these reserves represent less than 2% of proven phosphate reserves in Morocco.[citation needed]

sentences.en: Western Sahara's phosphate mine at Bou Craa produces approximately 10% of Morocco's annual phosphate output.[107] This mine has the longest conveyor belt in the world, at 98 km (61 mi).[108] However, these reserves represent less than 2% of proven phosphate reserves in Morocco.[citation needed]
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉 Bou Craa 的磷酸盐矿产量约占摩洛哥磷酸盐年产量的 10%。[107]该矿拥有世界上最长的传送带，长达 98 公里（61 英里）。[108]然而，这些储量仅占摩洛哥已探明磷酸盐储量的不到 2%。[需要引用]

blocks.html_en: Western Sahara's economy is based almost entirely on fishing, which employs two-thirds of its workforce, with mining, agriculture and tourism providing modest additional income. Most food for the urban population comes from Morocco. All trade and other economic activities are controlled by the Moroccan government (as its de facto southern province). The government has encouraged citizens to relocate to the territory by giving subsidies and price controls on basic goods. These heavy subsidies have created a state-dominated economy in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara.

sentences.en: Western Sahara's economy is based almost entirely on fishing, which employs two-thirds of its workforce, with mining, agriculture and tourism providing modest additional income.
sentences.zh: 西撒哈拉的经济几乎完全以渔业为基础，三分之二的劳动力从事渔业，采矿、农业和旅游业提供了微薄的额外收入。

sentences.en: Most food for the urban population comes from Morocco.
sentences.zh: 城市人口的大部分食物来自摩洛哥。

sentences.en: All trade and other economic activities are controlled by the Moroccan government (as its de facto southern province).
sentences.zh: 所有贸易和其他经济活动均由摩洛哥政府（作为其事实上的南部省份）控制。

sentences.en: The government has encouraged citizens to relocate to the territory by giving subsidies and price controls on basic goods.
sentences.zh: 政府通过对基本商品提供补贴和价格控制来鼓励公民搬迁到该地区。

sentences.en: These heavy subsidies have created a state-dominated economy in the Moroccan-occupied parts of Western Sahara.
sentences.zh: 这些巨额补贴在摩洛哥占领的西撒哈拉地区创造了国家主导的经济。

blocks.html_en: Due to the disputed nature of Moroccan sovereignty over the territory, the application of international accords to Western Sahara is highly ambiguous. Political leadership of trade agreement signatories such as the United States (US-Morocco Free Trade Agreement) and Norway (European Free Trade Association trade accord) have made statements as to these agreements' non-applicability – although practical policy application is ambiguous.[109][110][111]

sentences.en: Due to the disputed nature of Moroccan sovereignty over the territory, the application of international accords to Western Sahara is highly ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 由于摩洛哥对该领土的主权存在争议，国际协议对西撒哈拉的适用非常模糊。

sentences.en: Political leadership of trade agreement signatories such as the United States (US-Morocco Free Trade Agreement) and Norway (European Free Trade Association trade accord) have made statements as to these agreements' non-applicability – although practical policy application is ambiguous.[109][110][111]
sentences.zh: 美国（美国-摩洛哥自由贸易协定）和挪威（欧洲自由贸易联盟贸易协定）等贸易协定签署国的政治领导层已就这些协定的不适用性发表声明——尽管实际政策应用并不明确。[109][110][111]

blocks.html_en: In 2024, the European Court of Justice ruled that products harvested in Western Sahara and imported into the European Union must be labeled with their territory of origin, rather than as Moroccan.[112]

sentences.en: In 2024, the European Court of Justice ruled that products harvested in Western Sahara and imported into the European Union must be labeled with their territory of origin, rather than as Moroccan.[112]
sentences.zh: 2024年，欧洲法院裁定，在西撒哈拉收获并进口到欧盟的产品必须贴上原产地标签，而不是摩洛哥。 [112]

blocks.html_en: Exploitation of natural resources

sentences.zh: 自然资源开发
阿尤恩的卫星图像

blocks.html_en: After reasonably exploitable oil fields were located in Mauritania, speculation intensified on the possibility of major oil resources being located off the coast of Western Sahara. Despite the fact that findings remain inconclusive, both Morocco and the Polisario have signed deals with oil and gas exploration companies. US and French companies (notably TotalEnergies and Kerr-McGee) began prospecting on behalf of the Moroccan Office National de Recherches et d'Exploitations Petrolières (ONAREP).[113]

sentences.en: After reasonably exploitable oil fields were located in Mauritania, speculation intensified on the possibility of major oil resources being located off the coast of Western Sahara.
sentences.zh: 在毛里塔尼亚发现可合理开采的油田后，人们对西撒哈拉沿岸可能存在主要石油资源的猜测加剧。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that findings remain inconclusive, both Morocco and the Polisario have signed deals with oil and gas exploration companies.
sentences.zh: 尽管调查结果仍无定论，但摩洛哥和波利萨里奥都已与石油和天然气勘探公司签署了协议。

sentences.en: US and French companies (notably TotalEnergies and Kerr-McGee) began prospecting on behalf of the Moroccan Office National de Recherches et d'Exploitations Petrolières (ONAREP).[113]
sentences.zh: 美国和法国公司（特别是 TotalEnergies 和 Kerr-McGee）开始代表摩洛哥国家石油勘探与开发办公室 (ONAREP) 进行勘探。 [113]

blocks.html_en: In 2002, Hans Corell, Under-Secretary General of the United Nations and head of its Office of Legal Affairs, issued a legal opinion on the matter.[113] The opinion was rendered following an analysis of relevant provisions of the Charter of the United Nations, the United Nations General Assembly resolutions, the case law of the International Court of Justice and the practice of sovereign states.[113] It concluded that while the existing exploration contracts for the area were not illegal, "if further exploration and exploitation activities were to proceed in disregard of the interests and wishes of the people of Western Sahara, they would be in violation of the principles of international law."[113] After pressures from corporate ethics-groups, TotalEnergies pulled out in late 2004.[114]

sentences.en: In 2002, Hans Corell, Under-Secretary General of the United Nations and head of its Office of Legal Affairs, issued a legal opinion on the matter.[113] The opinion was rendered following an analysis of relevant provisions of the Charter of the United Nations, the United Nations General Assembly resolutions, the case law of the International Court of Justice and the practice of sovereign states.[113] It concluded that while the existing exploration contracts for the area were not illegal, "if further exploration and exploitation activities were to proceed in disregard of the interests and wishes of the people of Western Sahara, they would be in violation of the principles of international law."[113] After pressures from corporate ethics-groups, TotalEnergies pulled out in late 2004.[114]
sentences.zh: 2002年，联合国副秘书长兼法律事务办公室主任汉斯·科雷尔就此事发表了法律意见。 [113]该意见是在分析《联合国宪章》相关规定、联合国大会决议、国际法院判例法和主权国家实践后提出的。 [113]其结论是，虽然该地区现有的勘探合同并不违法，但“如果不顾西撒哈拉人民的利益和愿望而进行进一步的勘探和开采活动，就违反了国际法原则。”[113] 在企业道德团体的压力下，TotalEnergies 于 2004 年底退出。[114]

blocks.html_en: In May 2006, the remaining company, Kerr-McGee, also left, following sales of numerous shareholders like the National Norwegian Oil Fund, due to continued pressure from NGOs and corporate groups.[115]

sentences.en: In May 2006, the remaining company, Kerr-McGee, also left, following sales of numerous shareholders like the National Norwegian Oil Fund, due to continued pressure from NGOs and corporate groups.[115]
sentences.zh: 2006 年 5 月，由于非政府组织和企业集团的持续压力，在出售挪威国家石油基金等众多股东后，剩下的公司 Kerr-McGee 也离开了。 [115]

blocks.html_en: In December 2014, it became known that Seabird Exploration operated controversial seismic surveys offshore Western Sahara, in violation of the 2002 Hans Corell legal opinion.[116]

sentences.en: In December 2014, it became known that Seabird Exploration operated controversial seismic surveys offshore Western Sahara, in violation of the 2002 Hans Corell legal opinion.[116]
sentences.zh: 2014 年 12 月，人们得知 Seabird Exploration 在西撒哈拉近海进行了有争议的地震勘测，违反了 2002 年 Hans Corell 法律意见。 [116]

blocks.html_en: The European Union fishing agreements with Morocco include Western Sahara.

sentences.en: The European Union fishing agreements with Morocco include Western Sahara.
sentences.zh: 欧盟与摩洛哥的渔业协议包括西撒哈拉。

blocks.html_en: In a previously confidential legal opinion (published in February 2010, although it was forwarded in July 2009), the European Parliament's Legal Service opined that fishing by European vessels under a current EU–Morocco fishing agreement covering Western Sahara's waters is in violation of international law.[117]

sentences.en: In a previously confidential legal opinion (published in February 2010, although it was forwarded in July 2009), the European Parliament's Legal Service opined that fishing by European vessels under a current EU–Morocco fishing agreement covering Western Sahara's waters is in violation of international law.[117]
sentences.zh: 在一份先前保密的法律意见（于2010年2月发表，但于2009年7月转发）中，欧洲议会法律服务部认为，欧洲船只根据现行的欧盟-摩洛哥捕鱼协议在西撒哈拉水域进行捕鱼违反了国际法。 [117]

blocks.html_en: Similarly, the exploitation of phosphate mines in Bou Craa has led to charges of international law violations and divestment from several European states.[118]

sentences.en: Similarly, the exploitation of phosphate mines in Bou Craa has led to charges of international law violations and divestment from several European states.[118]
sentences.zh: 同样，布克拉磷酸盐矿的开采也导致了违反国际法的指控，并被多个欧洲国家撤资。 [118]
